    <p>My approach was shaped by an EPSRC-funded PhD at the University of Sussex, postdoctoral research in motion-aware medical imaging at the University of Graz, and faculty roles in Austria and the UK.</p>
    <p>At the University of Hull I held a permanent Lecturer in Applied Mathematics post—the UK academic grade closest to Assistant Professor—and served as Programme Director for the MSc in Mathematics.
